1.w: The plans of the heart [are] unto man, and from YHWH [is] the answer of the tongue.

2.w: All the ways of a man [are] pure in his own eyes, and YHWH weighs out the spirit.

3.w: Roll your works toward YHWH, and your plans will be established.

4.w: YHWH has made everything for its own end—even the wicked for the day of evil.

5.w: An abomination to YHWH [is] everyone high of heart; hand to hand, he will not be acquitted.

6.w: By loving devotion and faithfulness iniquity is atoned for, and by the fear of YHWH one turns aside from evil.

7.w: When the ways of a man please YHWH, He makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

8.w: Better [is] a little with righteousness than an abundance of increase without justice.

9.w: The heart of man plans his way, and YHWH establishes his step.

10.w: Divination [is] on the lips of the king; in judgment his mouth shall not be unfaithful.

11.w: A balance and scales of justice [are] unto YHWH; all the stones of the bag [are] His work.

12.w: An abomination to kings is to commit wickedness, for by righteousness a throne is established.

13.w: Lips of righteousness [are] the delight of kings, and one speaking uprightly he loves.

14.w: The wrath of a king [is as] messengers of death, and a wise man will appease it.

15.w: In the light of the face of a king [is] life, and his favor [is] like a cloud of spring rain.

16.w: To acquire wisdom—how much better than gold! And to acquire understanding [is] to be chosen above silver!

17.w: The highway of the upright ones turns aside from evil; one guarding his soul watches over his way.

18.w: Before the face of breaking [is] pride, and before a fall [is] a haughty spirit.

19.w: Better to be lowly spirit among the poor, than to divide plunder with proud ones.

20.w: One acting wisely concerning a matter will find good, and one trusting in YHWH [is] blessed.

21.w: The one wise of heart is called discerning, and sweetness of lips increases learning.

22.w: A fountain of life [is] understanding to its owners, and the discipline of fools [is] folly.

23.w: The heart of the wise causes his mouth to act wisely, and upon his lips he increases learning.

24.w: Words of pleasantness [are] a comb of honey—sweet to the soul and healing to the bone.

25.w: There is a way right before the face of a man, and its end is the way of death.

26.w: The soul of the laborer labors for himself, because his mouth presses him onward.

27.w: A man of worthlessness digs up evil, and upon his lips [it is] like a fire burning.

28.w: A man of perversity sends out strife, and a murmurer is separating a close friend.

29.w: A man of violence entices his neighbor and leads him in a way [that is] not good.

30.w: Winking his eyes to devise perversity, pursing his lips, he has accomplished evil.

31.w: Grey hair [is] a crown of glory; along the path of righteousness it is found.

32.w: Better [is] one slow to anger than a mighty one, and one ruling over his spirit than one taking a city.

33.w: Into the lap the lot is cast, and all its judgment [is] from YHWH.
